uncertainties.note: New Federation transmission exchange (Dewey/Holland/Renton). <op()> portrait-open commands do not reliably alternate one-to-one with speaker changes here (e.g. row 8739 addresses 'Dewey' by name under a fresh <op()>, so it cannot itself be Dewey speaking). No speaker identity or addressee was invented in any row; subjects/addressees are exactly what the source states or omits.
'Dad...' (fusan) - speaker and the person addressed are not settled by neighboring rows; kept as a bare exclamation.

Source itself puns on watashi/boku pronouns (one party objects to being called 'boku'); rendered as 'this guy'/'guy' to keep the source's own mislabeling joke without asserting a real gender identity.

Kids-sama rendered 'Lord Kids', reusing the locked surname 'Kids Munt' (encyclopedia_021_b.json/encyclopedia_022.json, Overman King Gainer); honorific-title rendering is new, proposed in batch_08696_glossary_proposals.json.
'These children' - referent left general as in source; likely the (Antibody) Coralians given combat context, not asserted as such.

validation.commands: Every angle-bracket command verified to match the source in exact order for all 80 rows (script cross-check against tools/dialogue_corpus.py output); none dropped or reordered.
validation.format: Original newline counts preserved for every row.
validation.fit: Full meaning kept; longest visible string checked <= 110 characters (see per-row notes for any compression).
validation.ascii: ASCII-only, straight quotes, '...' ellipses, no bare '%'; lowercase j/q avoided except the locked/established names 'Queen' and 'Kids'.
validation.terminology: Locked spellings from mission_terms_019.json (Coralian, Antibody Coralian, particle field), meeting_terms_015/glossary.json (New Federation), character_names_021.json (Dewey Novak, Holland Novak, Renton Thurston, Adroc Thurston, Gainer Sanga, Cynthia Lane/'Queen' nickname) and hud_labels.json (base, repair team, Flail team) reused throughout; see notes for the new 'Lord Kids' honorific proposal.
validation.meaning_review: Independent review of 80 rows against original ISO; 110 rows examined (8681-8790). One meaning fix applied (Lord Kizz -> Lord Kids, rows 08769/08771: the Siberian Railway president's name is Kids Munt, not Kizz Munt) - see review_08696.json.
